system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: After each Worker's action, the system updates the state and generates a focused prompt containing only essential context for the next task
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; prompts regenerated from central state per task. Worker system prompts carry role specifications.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Supervisor creates an Initial Plan based on the presented Raw Source Code.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: raw source of setup.py, __init__.py and imported files is injected up front; no navigation tools. Mismatch: source content, not a tree summary.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: CHASE avoids passing entire message lists and instead maintains all information in a central state variable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Deobfuscator tells the decrypted command to Supervisor.

tool_call_format.note: Paper-only; tool-call syntax not described, no repo.

tool_count.evidence_quote: TheTavilySearchtool enables identification of known malware campaigns and threat ac- tor patterns through web searches
tool_count.note: 3 Deobfuscator tools (decrypt_fernet_payload, decode_base64_payload, execute_python_code) + 3 Web Researcher tools (TavilySearch, fetch_content_at_url, inspect_domain_or_url_using_virustotal). Supervisor delegation mechanism not counted.

edit_primitive.note: Paper-only; the paper lists no file-editing tool, but no registry or code is available to confirm the absence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: our Supervisor dynamically adjusts its analysis plan based on Worker results.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Variables in the state include source codes, a log of executed sub-tasks, and pending analysis tasks

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A single Su- pervisor agent maintains the global analysis perspective and orchestrates the investigation, while specialized Worker agents execute domain-specific tasks.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Generating high-level task descriptions for Workers
delegation_mechanism.note: Workers share a central state; unclear whether new conversations are spawned.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Variables in the state include source codes, a log of executed sub-tasks, and pending analysis tasks

state_persistence.note: Supervisor can regenerate task prompts from preserved state after worker failure (within run); cross-run resume not described.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Supervisor's review of Worker outputs provides additional error detection opportunities.
self_verification.note: Closest value: Supervisor (different model size) reviews Worker outputs.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: our analysis of operational timeouts, which oc- curred due to the LLM's stochastic nature, suggests a simple automatic retry policy.
retry_policy.note: Retries in evaluation were manual reruns; automatic retry only proposed.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The Supervisor tracks an iteration bud- get, prioritizing high-value tasks as it depletes.
termination_condition.note: Supervisor decides completion (Sec. V.B step 7); 20-minute timeout in evaluation recorded under F3.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: we use budget-aware planning. The Supervisor tracks an iteration bud- get
cost_controls.note: Iteration budget closest to token_budget; tiered model assignment (Qwen3 32B/8B, Gemma3 4B) per role treated as routing.

timeouts.evidence_quote: safely executes code fragments in a sandboxed environment with an execution time limit of 1 minute.
timeouts.note: Per-run: 'we have set a 20-minute timeout' (Sec. V.A).

execution_isolation.note: Code execution tool runs 'in a sandboxed environment' but sandbox type unspecified.

tracing.note: Analysis trace figure shown (Fig. 3) but record format not described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: CHASE: LLM Agents for Dissecting Malicious PyPI Packages
target_domain.note: Security malware analysis of packages; includes web research tools.

open_source.note: Only a project page is given; no repository or licence in evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Uses local Qwen3/Gemma3 via SGLang; no client abstraction described.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our project page is available at: https://t0d4.github.io/CHASE-AIware25/

first_release_date.note: Fallback to paper v1 date; no repo/tag.
